caveats: Attribution to incident job 5079c33f-b4a6-4764-b610-e29718e0f9a0 is strong temporal and panel correlation, but the executor syslog does not include a job ID, so exact job identity is not directly proven.
The incident job's later OBSOLETE state and "panel lifecycle no longer accepts client mutation" error are downstream records and are not themselves proof of the initial circuit-triggering execution.

The Residential ownership filter is operating as designed on the supplied evidence. Removing or weakening it would expose preserved manual/default clients outside their immutable profile ownership.
This confirms the diagnosis from the supplied source, database facts, HTTP evidence, and syslog only; no implementation or live-state changes were assessed or performed.

recommended: Classify a pre-mutation ErrRuntimeCircuitOpen or equivalent temporary runtime acquisition failure as durable retryable unavailability, not as a reason to invoke the persistent fleet-wide fail-close gate.
Distinguish temporary pre-mutation failures from terminal validation errors, ownership/conflict errors, and genuinely ambiguous post-mutation outcomes.
Keep retries durable and bounded while retaining the existing serialized mutation concurrency.
Preserve read-before-retry and desired-state verification so retries remain idempotent and do not duplicate or overwrite clients.
Preserve exact panel, inbound, client, generation, email, route-class, and immutable profile-ownership checks.
Preserve all output eligibility and publication guards, including the profile ownership filter.
After correcting the error boundary, require an operator-domain controlled resume of the persistent execution gate with appropriate scope and validation.
excluded: Do not unconditionally auto-reopen a fail-closed mutation gate.
Do not remove or relax the immutable profile-ownership publication filter.
Do not treat terminal, conflict, or ambiguous post-mutation errors as ordinary blind retries.
Do not attribute the trigger conclusively to a specific job ID without direct executor logging.
Do not fold the separate UpCloud expiry/capacity loop or the ignored app/recovery.go next_retry_at ambiguity into this root cause.
